name: Joe Handelman '52 Princeton Fall Classic
headline: Joe Handelman '52 Princeton Fall Classic
summary: Final: Women: Elon won with 78 points, ahead of No. 24 Penn State (123) and Robert Morris and Monmouth (139 each); Robert Morris's Julia Dill won in 20:43.4, and host No. 25 Princeton placed sixth (185). Men: No. 8 Syracuse, which also won the Pre-Nationals men's race with another squad, scored 39 to William & Mary's 82 and Boston College's 128, while William & Mary's Hayes Trapp won in 24:08.5 and No. 24 Princeton was 11th (297).
